entities.name: Nakkhatra Mangala, 2nd Prince of Chanthaburi
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Prince Nakkhatra Mangala, 2nd Prince of Chanthaburi was the eldest son of Prince Kitiyakara Voralaksana, 1st Prince of Chanthaburi and Princess Apsarasaman Kitiyakara. He was the father of Queen Sirikit, father in-law of late Thai king King Bhumibol Adulyadej and maternal grandfather of the current King Vajiralongkorn. His birth name was His Serene Highness (Momchao) Prince Nakkhatra Mangala Kitiyakara, and his style and title was His Highness Prince Nakkhatra Mangala since 1950 when his daughter became queen.
